lodging_operating_format.label: Lodging / operating format
lodging_operating_format.value: Upper-upscale vacation ownership resorts (timeshare villas), plus exchange and rental services

room_inventory_ownership_scope.label: Room inventory / ownership scope
room_inventory_ownership_scope.value: Large portfolio of vacation villas across many resorts in several brand collections; units are sold to Owners, not hotel rooms

ownership_management_franchising.label: Ownership / management / franchising
ownership_management_franchising.value: Develops and sells vacation ownership interests, manages resorts and owner programs; uses Marriott, Hyatt and other hotel brands under license

hotel_demand_seasonality.label: Hotel demand / seasonality
hotel_demand_seasonality.value: Leisure vacation demand from Owners and families, peaking in holiday and school-break periods across resort destinations

brand_fee_contract_economics_asset_light.label: Brand fee / contract economics [asset-light operators]
brand_fee_contract_economics_asset_light.value: Pays license fees for hotel brand marks; earns revenue from timeshare sales, financing, resort management, exchange and rental fees

notes: Vacation ownership (timeshare) company, not a conventional hotel operator; hotel-style metrics are not disclosed in the evidence.
